purpose: Title-only job-family rules for ALIGN05 tech-occupation stratification and primary mapping. Skills text is NEVER an input (circularity firewall).
soc_reference: SOC 2018 detailed codes; O*NET-SOC 2019 crosswalk to be re-verified against the O*NET release at run time (O*NET database is public domain).
primary_tech_definition: Computing/IT occupations: O*NET-SOC 15-12xx computer occupations + data scientists + selected IT management. Exact codes:

primary_tech_soc_codes.15-1253: Software Quality Assurance Analysts and Testers

secondary_robustness_definition: Broad STEM: O*NET-SOC major groups 15 (Computer & Mathematical), 17 (Engineering & Architecture), 19 (Life, Physical, & Social Science). Used only as a secondary robustness mapping, never as the headline.

matching.order: negations first (force non-tech), then rules R01.. in listed order (first match wins), then default non-tech
